newsitem.title: USA: Emmis Broadcasting cash flow increases.
newsitem.headline: Emmis Broadcasting cash flow increases.

text.p: Emmis Broadcasting Corp said Thursday its broadcast cash flow increased to $15.9 million for the second quarter, up from $15.1 million a year ago.
Operating cash flow for the second quarter ended August 31 rose to $14.8 million, up 7.2 percent from $13.8 million a year ago.
Earlier, Emmis which owns and operates several broadcast stations, reported second quarter earnings of $0.53 a share, up from $0.38 last year.
